governing_equation: d2T_dx2 = pile_depth**2 / pile_effective_conductivity * (volumetric_air_exchange_coefficient * (T - ambient_temperature) - (1 - rod_solar_reflectance) * extinction_coefficient * solar_irradiance_daily_mean * exp(-extinction_coefficient * pile_depth * (1 - x)))
boundary_conditions: pile_effective_conductivity / pile_depth * dT_dx(0) + wall_solar_absorptance * solar_irradiance_daily_mean * exp(-extinction_coefficient * pile_depth) - wall_thermal_emittance * net_sky_longwave * exp(-extinction_coefficient * pile_depth) = wall_u_value * (T(0) - indoor_temperature)
pile_effective_conductivity / pile_depth * dT_dx(1) = external_heat_transfer_coefficient * (ambient_temperature - T(1)) - pile_top_emittance * net_sky_longwave

parameters.name: ambient_temperature
parameters.justification: Daily-mean outdoor air; x=0 is the wall surface, x=1 the pile tips.

parameters.name: wall_solar_absorptance
parameters.justification: Wall behind the pile keeps its aged white paint (SR 0.67).

parameters.name: net_sky_longwave
parameters.justification: Vertical surface, half sky view; the wall's sky view through the pile scales with its gap fraction exp(-kappa*L).

parameters.name: external_heat_transfer_coefficient
parameters.justification: Outer film at the pile tips.

parameters.name: pile_top_emittance
parameters.justification: Only part of the sky-facing longwave exchange is lumped at the tips; the rest is inside the pile.

parameters.name: extinction_coefficient
parameters.justification: Lower bound 0 = no rods (bare painted wall as baseline).
